definitions.gloss: monthly installment; monthly proration; monthly basis
definitions.explanation: Dividing a total amount into monthly portions, or calculating something on a per-month basis. Commonly used for payments, fees, and accounting.

examples.japanese: {月割|つきわ}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{支払|しはら}う→支払う：02116_shiharau⟧。
⟦{年会費|ねんかいひ}→年会費：06414_nenkaihi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{月割|つきわ}り⟦{計算|けいさん}する→計算する：25526_keisansuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{一|ひと}か{月|げつ}⟦{千円|せんえん}→千円：08980_senen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: If you prorate the annual membership fee monthly, it comes to 1,000 yen per month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧⟦{入会|にゅうかい}→入会：11671_nyuukai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{月割|つきわ}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{精算|せいさん}→精算：10899_seisan⟧⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: In the case of mid-term enrollment, fees will be settled on a prorated monthly basis.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧ (month) and {割|わ}り (division, rate). Used in business, accounting, and subscription contexts to describe breaking annual or total amounts into monthly portions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {月割|つきわ}り⟦{計算|けいさん}→計算：02697_keisan⟧: monthly proration calculation
- {月割|つきわ}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧: to pay monthly
- {月割|つきわ}り⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧: prorated monthly fee
- {月割|つきわ}り{額|がく}: monthly prorated amount

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {月払|つきばら}い: monthly payment — focuses on the act of paying monthly rather than the calculation
- ⟦{分割払|ぶんかつばら}い→分割払い：17607_bunkatsubarai⟧: installment payment — more general; can be any interval
- ⟦{日割|ひわ}り→日割り：18920_hiwari⟧: daily proration — the same concept applied on a daily basis
